** Transactions for the Snapshot **

Transactions Overview
   # Wind down the v0 advanced-staking program: (1) create a vesting pool funding 5,492,496.05 ZKP, (2) move its start into the past so the entire allocation is releasable, (3-4) release the two splits, (5-6) approve + bridge the 392,496.05 ZKP shortfall to the Polygon Vault via the Polygon PoS bridge, (7) drain the AdvancedStakeRewardController balance into the Vault on Polygon (Mode-B bridge), (8) set the Merkle root on VaultV0Frozen to open the claim window (Mode-B bridge). All 8 transactions are signed by the Ethereum DAO Multisig.
    1. addVestingPools on 0xb476…F14B // Create new vesting pool 23 (5,492,496.05 ZKP — 392,496.05 for the claim-window APY shortfall + 5,100
    2. updatePoolTime on 0xb476…F14B // Move pool 23 start time into the past so the 5,492,496.05 ZKP allocation becomes immediately releasa
    3. releaseTo on 0xb476…F14B // Release 392,496.05 ZKP from pool 23 to the DAO multisig — used to top up the Polygon Vault for the c
    4. releaseTo on 0xb476…F14B // Release 5,100,000 ZKP from pool 23 to the Base deployer wallet — will be manually bridged to Base ou
    5. approve on 0x909E…a173 // Approve the Polygon PoS bridge ERC-20 predicate to spend 392,496.05 ZKP from the DAO multisig
    6. depositFor on 0xA0c6…7C77 // Bridge 392,496.05 ZKP through the Polygon PoS bridge with the Vault proxy on Polygon as the recipien
    7. FxRoot@eth::sendMessageToChild(MaticBridgeModule, encodedPayload) // bridge rescueErc20 on 0x8f15…4de3 (Drain the AdvancedStakeRewardController's full ZKP balance into the Vault)
    8. FxRoot@eth::sendMessageToChild(MaticBridgeModule, encodedPayload) // bridge setRoot on 0x5E7F…86c9 (Update the on-chain root on VaultV0Frozen — opens the claim window)
